outgoing.name: Algorithm
outgoing.excerpt: The algorithm was initially controversial, with classified design elements, a relatively short key length, and suspicions about a National Security Agency (NSA) backdoor.

outgoing.name: Russia
outgoing.excerpt: In the USSR GOST 28147-89 algorithm was introduced, with 64-bit block size and 256-bit key, which was also used in Russia later.

outgoing.name: United States
outgoing.excerpt: …an official Federal Information Processing Standard (FIPS) for the United States in 1976, and which has subsequently enjoyed widespread use…
